subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help-only for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but the remaining configurable-keybinding request would add a public OpenClaw surface that needs product/API ownership under the repository config policy.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in docs and `/help` while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define and test a narrow TUI keybinding/config or CLI bridge into pi-tui so users can choose send/newline keys.

options.title: Fold Into Composer Backlog
options.body: Track configurable TUI send keys with broader external-editor, vi-mode, and long-prompt composer work before adding new public surface.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in docs and `/help` while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They already scoped this issue and authored the adjacent shortcut resolution, making them the strongest observed owner for the product-surface choice.
